text_markup: The Runner uses {card:Detente} to access a card in HQ while there is no run in progress. They access {card:Ganked!} and are forced to encounter {card:Loot Box}. The Runner chooses to neither break any subroutines nor spend credits for {card:Loot Box}'s first subroutine, so that subroutine tries to end the run. There is no run to end, but this effect still ends the encounter. The second subroutine on {card:Loot Box} will not resolve.
